capabilities: Sync Gumroad sales into a ledger note with totals, fees and refunds
Maintain product notes with a sales section and sales frontmatter properties
Render a gumroad-sales block showing sales for a day or date range
Re-check recent sales on each sync so refunds and chargebacks stay current
Rebuild the ledger from full sales history
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Amounts are reported in USD only; processor fees, taxes and payouts are excluded from its figures.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull sales data from Gumroad or track product revenue and refunds inside notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks only to api.gumroad.com, and only when you sync.

summary: Syncs Gumroad sales into a vault: a ledger note, running totals and frontmatter in product notes, and a sales block for daily notes.
